page_summary:
In Pursuit of VALIS: Selections from the Exegesis is the canonical works record for PKD's primary text. It gathers 2 archive manifestations under one bibliographic heading so edition history, duplication, adaptation, or later republication can be read together. The manifestations span 2 archive PDFs. Visible examples include In Pursuit of VALIS: Selections from the Exegesis (1991), In Pursuit of VALIS: Selections from the Exegesis (OceanofPDF edition) (1991). The longest manifestation in the set runs 313 pages.
